# MentorCloud

> MentorCloud is the #1 ranked enterprise mentoring platform that uses AI-powered matching to connect mentors and mentees for career development, employee retention, and organizational growth.

MentorCloud provides comprehensive mentoring software solutions for enterprises, higher education institutions, and organizations seeking to build knowledge-sharing cultures. The platform combines intelligent mentor matching, program administration tools, and engagement features to drive talent development and employee retention.
